title: Back to Frustration Mall
content: I had hopes that my frustration dreams at my mall were over as last week things went so smoothly but last night, I successfully bought two items, then I set them down in a store while browsing and spent the rest of the night trying to finding by repeatedly retracing my steps. It then turned in to a new report that the set of one of the morning news was set on fire. I think that was from seeing reports of ballot boxes being burned. My dreams are often influenced by television and reels.
